title: CADWorld: Computer-Use Benchmark for Long-Horizon Computer-Aided Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.16251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents are increasingly evaluated in realistic desktop environments, but existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of professional engineering workflows whose outputs are persistent, structured artifacts. Mechanical computer-aided design (CAD) is a particularly demanding setting: an agent must manipulate geometry and constraints over long interaction horizons while producing a native project whose dimensions, construction structure, and downstream engineering state remain valid. We introduce \textbf{CADWorld}, a benchmark for long-horizon computer use in FreeCAD. CADWorld contains 200 tasks spanning 11 mechanical-CAD workflow categories, including sketching, part modeling, assembly, CAM, FEM, measurement, mesh processing, and technical drawing. translated_title: CADWorld：面向长时程计算机辅助设计的计算机使用基准测试
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体越来越多地在真实的桌面环境中进行评估，但现有基准测试对专业工程工作流程的覆盖有限，而这些工作流程的输出是持久的、结构化的制品。机械计算机辅助设计（CAD）是一个要求尤为苛刻的场景：智能体必须在长交互时程中操作几何图形与约束，同时生成一个原生项目，且该项目的尺寸、构造结构和下游工程状态必须保持有效。我们提出了CADWorld，一个面向FreeCAD中长时程计算机使用的基准测试。CADWorld包含200个任务，涵盖11个机械CAD工作流程类别，包括草图绘制、零件建模、装配、CAM（计算机辅助制造）、FEM（有限元分析）、测量、网格处理和技术制图。智能体通过截图和GUI操作进行交互，而任务成功与否由针对保存的FreeCAD制品及辅助输出的任务特定可执行检查来判定，涵盖几何……
tldr: CADWorld是一个基于FreeCAD的长时程计算机使用基准测试，包含覆盖11个机械CAD工作流程类别的200个任务，并通过可执行检查验证智能体所生成的原生CAD制品的几何、结构和工程状态有效性。
en_tdlr: CADWorld is a long-horizon computer-use benchmark in FreeCAD comprising 200 tasks across 11 mechanical-CAD workflow categories, where agent success is verified through executable checks on saved native CAD artifacts.
